name: quotini
description: Invoice generator with Firebase accounts, private cloud storage, and local draft recovery.

scripts.build: npm run verify:vendor && npm run build:firebase && node scripts/build-static.js
scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check backend.js && node --check outbox.js && node --check sw.js && node --check scripts/vendor-manifest.js && node --check scripts/sync-vendor.js && node --check scripts/verify-vendor.js && node --check scripts/build-static.js && node --check tests/browser-backend-mock.js && node --check tests/outbox.test.js && node --check tests/infrastructure.test.js && node --check tests/app.test.js && node --check firebase-backend.mjs && node --check scripts/build-firebase.js
scripts.test: npm run check && node --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-concurrency=1 tests/google-sign-in.test.mjs tests/outbox.test.js tests/infrastructure.test.js tests/app.test.js
scripts.test:firebase: npm run build:firebase && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.prototype.json --project demo-ledgerly --only auth,firestore,storage "node --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-concurrency=1 tests/firebase.test.mjs tests/firebase-storage.test.mjs tests/firebase-browser.test.js"
scripts.prototype: npm run build:firebase && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.prototype.json --project demo-ledgerly --only auth,firestore,storage "node scripts/run-prototype.mjs"
scripts.test:webkit: npm run build:firebase && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.prototype.json --project demo-ledgerly --only auth,firestore,storage "node --test --test-timeout=120000 tests/firebase-webkit.test.js"
